# iKAN Health

> iKAN Health (ikanhealth.in) is an India-based mental wellness platform offering self-guided mental health assessments, structured "Equip" programs, mood journaling, and access to professional consultations. Our mission is to make mental healthcare accessible, affordable, and transparent.

## About
- [About iKAN](https://ikanhealth.in/about): Our story, mission, and team.
- [Contact](https://ikanhealth.in/contact): Support email support@ikanhealth.in, phone 8527545503.

## Assessments
Self-guided, evidence-informed screeners that help users understand how they're feeling.
- [Feeling worried and stressed](https://ikanhealth.in/assessment/feeling-worried-and-stressed)
- [Feeling overwhelmed and anxious](https://ikanhealth.in/assessment/feeling-overwhelmed-and-anxious)
- [Feeling depressed and hopeless](https://ikanhealth.in/assessment/feeling-depressed-and-hopeless)
- [Feeling drained and burned out](https://ikanhealth.in/assessment/feeling-drained-and-burned-out)
- [Struggling with quality sleep](https://ikanhealth.in/assessment/struggling-with-quality-sleep)
- [Struggling to balance life](https://ikanhealth.in/assessment/struggling-to-balance-life)
- [Unsure or general concern](https://ikanhealth.in/assessment/unsure-or-general-concern)

## Equip programs
Structured, self-paced programs with daily modules, exercises, and progress tracking.
- [Sleep Tight](https://ikanhealth.in/equip/sleep-tight)
- [Productivity Reset](https://ikanhealth.in/equip/productivity-reset)
- [Stress Buster](https://ikanhealth.in/equip/stress-buster)
- [Unburn (burnout recovery)](https://ikanhealth.in/equip/burnout-reset)

## Notes
- iKAN is not an emergency service. In a crisis in India, contact the KIRAN Mental Health Helpline 1800-599-0019 (24x7), iCALL 9152987821, or emergency services on 112.
